Bitcoin tests key swing area low. A break below will target the 2026 lows
news.summary:
Bitcoin moved to its lowest level since early July, trading down to $61,160. That took the price $23 below the $61,183 level that marks the bottom of a key swing area on the four-hour chart, but momentum faded and the price has bounced modestly.  The buyers are trying to hold onto some control. .

The move lower extends the decline from the November 4 swing high to about $20,000, or 24.6%. From the September 21 high at $87,374, the price is down 30%. The sellers have been in control, and they are now getting another chance to push the price through support that has held since early July.

The $61,183 to $62,470 swing area is the barometer

The first question is whether sellers can keep the price below $61,183 and build momentum. The initial break took the price only $23 below the floor. A move back above $61,183 would put the price back inside the swing area and give buyers some breathing room.

The more important level for buyers is $62,470, the top of the swing area. It would take a move above that level, and the ability to stay above it, to give buyers some hope that a corrective move higher can develop. Until then, sellers can lean against the upper end of the swing area and use a move above it to define their risk.

A break with momentum puts the lows for the year in focus

If sellers can get and stay below $61,183, traders will start to look toward the June and July lows between $57,735 and $58,035. The first target is $58,035, followed by the low for the year at $57,735.

That puts the next major support area roughly $3,100 to $3,400 below today’s low. There is room for the price to run if sellers can turn the initial break into a sustained move lower. The year’s lows would then give buyers another area to lean against, with risk defined on a break below $57,735.

The trading lesson

When the price breaks a swing area by just $23 after falling about $20,000, what happens next matters more than the initial print. If the price bounces back above $61,183, watch what happens on a retest. If buyers hold that level, they have a nearby place to define risk and a clear hurdle at $62,470. If the price stays below $61,183 and rallies stall against it from underneath, the old floor starts to act as resistance.
